name: Flexiv
summary:
Flexiv develops adaptive robots that combine industrial force control, computer vision and AI. Founded in 2016 by a team with roots in Stanford robotics and artificial intelligence research, the company develops robot hardware and integrated solutions for customers across industries.

Its technical focus is on robots that can respond to contact and variations in the work environment, rather than depend exclusively on precisely repeated positioning. The business combines robot systems with application development and support, connecting manipulation technology with practical production tasks. Flexiv maintains research, business and manufacturing operations across several regions, including China, the United States and Europe.
